trigger_condition: chargeback_attribution accepted as any free-form string, no enum/pattern constraint
potential_consequence: Typo'd or wrong-case values pass API validation and reach the DB layer unchecked

trigger_condition: chargeback_attribution is any value other than the exact string 'cost_center' (e.g. '', 'Cost_Center', 'foo')
guard_snippet: if chargeback_attribution not in (None, "project", "cost_center"): raise ExtendedHTTPException(code=400, message="Invalid chargeback attribution")
potential_consequence: Invalid value flows through to repository.update_project, violates the DB CheckConstraint on flush, raising an unhandled IntegrityError (surfaces as 500) since update_project has no try/except around this call

trigger_condition: customer_config has no explicit 'features:projectChargeback' entry for a customer
guard_snippet: is_feature_enabled("projectChargeback") should default True to match its own docstring, or configs must be pre-seeded before rollout
potential_consequence: is_component_enabled defaults missing feature keys to False, so the previously-ungated chargeback_enabled update path now 403s for every customer lacking the new config entry

trigger_condition: clear_cost_center=True while chargeback_attribution is omitted from the same update request
potential_consequence: Project ends up with chargeback_attribution='cost_center' but cost_center_id=NULL, an orphaned/inconsistent attribution never reconciled
